fix: In 'internodes of distal branches X mm wide', the measured part is the internode named first. 'of distal branches' only says where the internode is. It is not the bearer.
reason: The 2 mm width belongs to the internodes of the distal branches, not to the branches as a whole.
The peduncle is said to be longer than the leaves. The towards target 'leaf' is right.

fix: 'velus au dehors, glabres en dedans' would be more precise with an outer-surface place slot. Even without it, the sepal really is hairy.
reason: The sepals are hairy on the outside. Saying the sepal is hairy is true; it just leaves out where.
'racemes densely many-flowered' means many flowers in the inflorescence. The container slot is the inflorescence.

fix: This would be more precise with a place slot for the dorsal midrib. 'peu distincts' only weakens the tubercles; it does not remove them.
reason: The dorsal face of the endocarp has a midrib of (faint) tubercles, so 'tuberculate endocarp' holds.

fix: A hyphenated shape compound such as 'campanulate-cylindric' is one in-between shape: cylindric, leaning toward campanulate. It should not become a separate 'campanulate' alternative.
reason: The second alternative is campanulate-cylindric, not campanulate. Listing plain campanulate as an alternative overstates it.
'Plants 3–5(–8+) dm' is plant height. Converting to 30–80 cm, including the extreme in brackets, is right.
The glumes are obtuse or at most mucronate. These two shape alternatives (both about the tip) are read correctly.

fix: In 'upper leaf cells ...; lower cells ...', the position word 'upper' must go into a position slot. Without it, the quality spreads to all leaf cells.
reason: Only the upper leaf cells are mammillose. The lower cells are described separately as thin-walled and hyaline.
The plants are said to have a soft pale bluish colour. 'Blue' with the qualifier 'approximately' fits 'bluish'.
'Styles nearly as long as calyx lobes': same length, ratio about 1, with 'approximately'. Read correctly.
An umbellule is an inflorescence. 'many-flowered' means many flowers are present in it.
'subovate' means roughly ovate. Ovate with 'approximately' is right.

fix: In 'those of winter X; those of summer Y', the season belongs in a state slot. Also, the range 'lanceolate to sublinear' lost its upper end (narrowly linear).
reason: The shape is given only for winter leaves. Summer leaves are only said to be smaller. Also, 'sublinear' is missing from the values.
The bark is furrowed at maturity, and the context slot 'mature' (PATO_0001701) captures that.
The leaf blade is ± acute at the apex. Acute with 'approximately' on the lamina follows the pattern.

fix: In 'exceeding apex of X', the comparison is with X (the florets). The word 'apex' only says the glume reaches beyond their tip; it is not the part being compared.
reason: The glumes are longer than the florets. The towards target was set to 'apex' instead of the florets.
The trunk is fissured at the base. Using stem base with stem as the outer part is right.
'Feuilles 2–5' means 2 to 5 leaves.
'gracile' means slender.
'Caespitose, tightly tuft-forming' fits the caespitose value.

fix: In moss descriptions (setae, opercula, annuli, peristome), 'capsule' means the moss capsule, which is a sporangium. It is not a capsule fruit.
reason: Brachydontium is a moss. Its capsule is a sporophyte sporangium, not a fruit.

fix: When 'X at base' is set against 'Y distally', the place 'at base' must be kept.
reason: The exostome teeth are striolate only at the base. Further up (distally) they are trabeculate.
The umbels are 5–12-flowered: 5–12 flowers per inflorescence.
The lamina base and apex are ± acute. This fits acute with 'approximately'.

fix: In 'stamens with filaments X mm long', the measurement belongs to the part after 'with', not to the stamen.
reason: The 5.5 mm is the filament length, not the stamen length.
The leaflets are pubescent on both sides.
The capsule ranges from smooth to verrucose. Texture on the fruit, read as a continuum, is right.
'pappi 0.2–1 mm' is pappus length in FNA style.

fix: 'ca.' should give the qualifier 'approximately', as 'nearly' did in A05770.
reason: The flora says the style is about 1 cm. The number and unit match the text.
